audit.why: 54.83% over 1386 games. You own levels 1-3 and the lane drifts even from there — the page already says so, and unusually for this champion's data the packet reports no defects at all.
Spike placement is right and matches the kit: your 1-3 window before Indestructible stacks, his level 6, his two-item AP timing.

Rare on this champion's pages — every ability description checks out against Riot's text. Obliterate does deal increased damage to a single target, Death's Grasp does pull, Indestructible does store damage into a shield he can consume as a heal, and Realm of Death does steal stats. Nothing needed correcting; what it needed was numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says 'respect his R cooldown' and 'dodge his E-pull' without a single number attached.
audit.why: Death's Grasp is 16/14/12/10/8s — at rank 1 the longest basic cooldown either of you has, longer than Aegis Assault early and far longer than Shield Vault. His entire engage depends on it, so a dodged pull is sixteen seconds of free lane, which is a much stronger instruction than 'dodge it'. Realm of Death is 140/120/100s, so surviving one buys well over two minutes where he cannot isolate you. Obliterate is 8s falling to 4s, Indestructible 12s to 8s.
audit.corrected: The 16s on Death's Grasp and 140s on Realm of Death written into early, mid and the level-6 spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Indestructible's healing is named as the reason your burst stops working, in four places, and Grievous Wounds is never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Mordekaiser stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.' Anti-heal is the direct counter to the exact mechanic the page identifies as your problem, and its absence is the largest gap here.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are yours. Your Level 1 W is a point-and-click stun that damages him before his Q slam or W shield exist, and your Q taps poke him off every minion he reaches for. He has no dash to escape your W-gap, so trade hard: W in, Q-tap, then E-block his Q isolation slam so it does nothing back. Dodge his E-pull — if he never lands the pull, his whole engage falls apart and you keep poking with held-Q.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are yours. Shield Vault is a point-and-click stun that lands before Obliterate or Indestructible matter, and Comet Spear taps poke him off every minion. He has no dash to escape 600 range, so trade hard: vault in, tap the spear, then face Aegis Assault at Obliterate so the slam does nothing back. Dodge Death's Grasp above all — it is 16s at rank 1, so a missed pull hands you sixteen seconds of free lane.

edits.before: Through 4-5 you stay ahead with empowered-Q poke and E blocks shutting off his slam, but his W shield-heal is now stacking, so don't sit in extended trades — burst-and-back. At 6 the lane shifts: his R Realm of Death yanks you into an isolated 1v1 and steals your stats, and his sustain wins a long fight there. Hold W to bait, but respect his R cooldown — if he has it and you're below half, look to roam with your own R instead of dueling.
edits.after: Through 4-5 you stay ahead with empowered Comet Spear, but Indestructible now stores every hit you land and gives it back as a heal, so burst and leave rather than grind. Obliterate falls to 4s at max rank; Death's Grasp is the one to count at 16s down to 8s. At 6, Realm of Death isolates you and steals your stats, and his sustain wins that room — but it is 140s at rank 1. Under half health with it up, roam with Grand Starfall instead of duelling.

edits.before: This is where Mordekaiser takes over. Once he hits Riftmaker and Rylai's, his W shield-heal soaks your front-loaded burst and his DoT damage out-grinds your squishy frame — and his R can isolate you away from your team to delete you. Your damage has plateaued while his AP scaled. So bank your early lead into towers and Grand Starfall roams, and close the game before ~2 items make his death-realm 1v1 unbeatable.
edits.after: This is where Mordekaiser takes over. Riftmaker and Rylai's turn Indestructible into a shield he cashes as a heal that eats your entire front-loaded combo — which makes Grievous Wounds the item deciding whether you can fight him at all, and nothing on this page had said so. Darkness Rise grinds you down while your damage plateaus. Bank the early lead into towers and Grand Starfall roams, and close before two items make his realm unbeatable.

notes: Unusually clean page — every ability description matches Riot's text, which is not true of most matchups in this slice, and the packet reports no defects. What it lacked was numbers and one item. The most useful addition is Death's Grasp at 16/14/12/10/8s: at rank 1 that is the longest basic cooldown in the matchup, so 'dodge his E-pull' becomes 'a missed pull is sixteen free seconds'. Realm of Death at 140s means surviving one buys over two minutes. The real gap was Grievous Wounds — the page names Indestructible's healing four times as the reason your burst stops working and never mentions anti-heal.
